§3§lPurpose and mechanism§r
Withered Breath can be collected in Prosperity's Withered Riverbed. Condensing, dissolution, and extraction recover cadmium, alumina, gallium, niobium, indium, and other metals, alongside a borax branch. Check one named raw-fluid cell filled with §11000§r mB of Withered Breath. §2The cell is not consumed§r; building the industrial line is not required.

§3§lPreparation and operation§r
Metal recovery passes through condensation, dissolution, and extraction rather than directly producing ingots from collection. Keep a full cell for the target, then select metal or borax processing according to demand. Intermediate solutions do not replace the raw-fluid inventory goal. For expansion, check reagents, recipes, and destinations without mixing in another raw-fluid workflow.
